ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the latitudinal distribution of apple cultivation, with latitude positions such as 0°, 20°, 40°, and 60°N marked horizontally. The legend shows that apple “special producing areas” are located in the low-latitude range of 0°—20°; “main producing areas” are concentrated in the middle and high latitudes of about 40°—60°N; and there are also “secondary producing areas” near 20°—40°N and 60°N. Reasoning: Apples are usually suitable for growing in relatively cold and cool middle- and high-latitude regions, while the heat conditions in low-latitude regions of 0°—20° are generally relatively high, and they are not typical apple-suitable areas. If special apple producing areas can form in low-latitude regions, it is usually because terrain such as mountains and plateaus raises the altitude and lowers the temperature, thereby forming a cold and cool environment similar to that of middle and high latitudes. Therefore, the main factor in the formation of special apple producing areas is terrain.

method.method_draft: 读图确定“特殊产地”处于0°—20°低纬，而苹果主要产地在中高纬。结合题干询问“特殊产地形成的主要因素”，判断低纬正常情况下热量过高，不是苹果典型适生区；只有山地或高原地形通过海拔升高降低气温，提供类似中纬度的冷凉环境。因此回答主要因素为地形。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是苹果种植的纬度分布示意图，横向标出0°、20°、40°、60°N等纬度位置。图例显示，苹果“特殊产地”位于0°—20°的低纬度范围；“主要产地”集中在约40°—60°N的中高纬度；20°—40°N和60°N附近还有“次要产地”。推理：苹果通常适宜在较冷凉的中高纬地区生长，而0°—20°低纬地区热量条件一般偏高，不是典型苹果适生区。低纬地区若能形成苹果特殊产地，通常是因为山地、高原等地形使海拔升高，气温降低，从而形成类似中高纬的冷凉环境。因此，苹果特殊产地形成的主要因素是地形。

claims.source: If low-latitude regions can form special apple-producing areas, it is usually because terrain such as mountains and plateaus causes elevation to rise and temperature to decrease, thereby forming cool environments similar to those of middle and high latitudes

claims.claim: The main factor in the formation of special apple-producing areas is terrain.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore, the main factor in the formation of special apple-producing areas is terrain
